title: Third-order invariance estimate
statement:
Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ and $(\Xi,\nu)$ be probability spaces, and let $F$ be a multilinear coefficient family on subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ of degree at most $k$. Suppose $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ are independent under $\mu$ and $Y_1,\ldots,Y_n$ are independent under $\nu$, and that each coordinate variable is $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive for some $0<\rho<1$, has mean zero, and has second moment one. If $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is three times continuously differentiable and $|\psi'''(t)|\le C$ for all $t$, where $C\ge0$, then
\[
\left|\mathbb E_\mu\psi(F(X))-\mathbb E_\nu\psi(F(Y))\right|
\le \frac{C}{3}\left(\frac1\rho\right)^{3k}\sum_{i=1}^n \mathrm{Inf}_i[F]^{{3}/{2}}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $\mu,\nu$ are probability measures on measurable spaces
$F$ is a coefficient family of degree at most $k$
the coordinates of $X$ are independent under $\mu$
the coordinates of $Y$ are independent under $\nu$
each coordinate of $X$ and $Y$ is $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive under its measure
each coordinate of $X$ and $Y$ has mean zero
each coordinate of $X$ and $Y$ has second moment one
